card.name: Partway into plant and tree words
card.fires_on: Partway through words about trees, plants and forestry, such as arborist, tassels, deforested, blossom or rapeseed, where the next piece could lead toward 'tree'. It also fires on a few unrelated spots.

modes.label: Split plant words
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a long plant or forestry word, such as arborist, rapeseed or deforested.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word tree or trees, and away from unrelated name endings and rare characters.
